arguments.summary: The p99 latency spike is linked to the pgbouncer connection pool refresh, not the recent deployment. The pgbouncer pool status is currently degraded with 100 connections in use and no worker throughput. The failed_jobs table in the jobs database has been growing, and the export using pg_dump is ongoing. A sample of the failed jobs has been queried to provide initial insights for further analysis.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Continue monitoring pgbouncer and the failed_jobs backlog. Once the pg_dump export is complete, review the failed_jobs data to identify the root cause of the failures and take appropriate actions to resolve the issues and clear the backlog.
